meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 它会把这个只读网页仪表盘复制到 tools/clidash、生成配置并启动本机服务(默认 127.0.0.1:4690)。每个能按 JSON 列出资源的 CLI 各有一个标签页,表格列随数据自动生成;另含代理总览、活动图表、日志与文件查看。
howto.when: 当你想为 NanoClaw 的 ncl(或 docker、kubectl 等能按 JSON 列出资源的 CLI)搭一个只读的本地网页仪表盘时触发,例如输入 /add-clidash。

say.text: 用 /add-clidash 给 NanoClaw 装一个只读网页仪表盘
把 docker 也加进 clidash 配置,让它多一个标签页
clidash 里 ncl 的标签页是空的,帮我排查
say.note: 通常是 bin/ncl 没构建或路径填错

howto.what_en: It copies the clidash read-only dashboard into tools/clidash, creates a config, and serves it on 127.0.0.1:4690. Every CLI that lists resources as JSON gets a tab with runtime-derived columns, plus extra NanoClaw panels.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a read-only local web dashboard over NanoClaw's ncl, docker, kubectl, or any other CLI that lists resources as JSON.

say_en.text: Run /add-clidash to set up a read-only dashboard for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies clidash to tools/clidash and starts it locally

say_en.text: Add docker to the clidash config so it gets its own tab
The ncl tab in clidash is empty — help me debug it
say_en.note: Usually bin/ncl isn't built or the path is wrong
